environment.description: Container deployed via ECS task definition with readonlyRootFilesystem:true. The task uses a custom-built distroless image with no shell. Volume configuration specifies zero EFS or EBS mounts. The Fargate platform version 1.4.0 ephemeral storage (20GB /dev/shm excluded) has no bind mounts configured. Container insights agent confirms no tmpfs overlays provisioned. The container's /proc/mounts shows only the read-only overlay root and /proc, /sys pseudo-filesystems. Note: the application still compiles and starts successfully since the bind/listen syscall operates on sockets not filesystem, but any write() to a filesystem path returns EROFS.

config.ephemeral_storage: default 20GiB but no paths exposed as writable
config.proc_mounts_excerpt:
overlay / overlay ro,relatime 0 0
proc /proc proc rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec 0 0
tmpfs /dev tmpfs rw,nosuid,size=65536k 0 0
